description: List and inspect CI/CD variables for projects or groups. Actions: list (all variables with pagination), get (single variable by key with environment scope filter). Related: manage_variable to create/update/delete.

filter.description: Filter parameters for variable lookup Required for 'get' action(s).

environment_scope.description: The environment scope filter. Use "*" for all environments or specific environment name like "production".

key.description: The key of the CI/CD variable. Maximum 255 characters, alphanumeric and underscore only. Required for 'get' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_variables
